method: Independent recompute directly from raw DATA/ATLAS/1s/<day>.parquet for each of the 100 sampled days -- no import/call into pipeline/detectors.py. TRIGGER: box_hi/box_lo/box_pt via a boolean timestamp mask (ts-60, ts] (not pandas .rolling), flips via the documented sign-reversal rule applied to the whole-day close array then summed in-window, ambient_pt via independent per-minute high/low bucketing (np.maximum/minimum.reduceat on ts//60) + median of the trailing 60 minutes strictly before the bar's own minute, box_ambient_ratio and esc_buf=0.5*box_pt recomputed arithmetically. Verified recomputed values actually satisfy the detector's own thresholds (cnt>=40, flips>=30, box<=0.6*ambient, RTH 09:30-15:30 ET). OUTCOME: escaped/escape_lag_s/escape_dir/escape_px recomputed by a fresh forward scan of bars strictly after the fire bar (30min horizon, 16:00 ET hard clip, buffer=0.5*box_pt); mag_5m/15m/30m recomputed via the documented _at_offset rule.
